findings.evidence: Scratch worktree at 9ecc33394, mutant M3 `(event === undefined || event === 'message')` -> `(event === 'message')` in the removeAllListeners override: `pnpm -s test:parity child_process/` -> 30 cases, all match; `npx vitest run --project unit packages/runtime-js/src/ipc packages/runtime-js/src/builtins/process packages/io/src/event-emitter` -> 26 files / 181 tests passed. Scratch parity probe path `p.on('message', handler); p.removeAllListeners(); setTimeout(() => { p.send('hung'); p.disconnect(); }, 500).unref()`: Node v24.16.0 ["armed"] 0; HEAD ["armed"] 0; M3 ["armed","hung"] 0. (`clearAll` does not discriminate: M3 keeps refs 2 there, Node 1, both held.) Other mutants killed by the committed case: M1 (predecessor's mutant: `#syncIpcKeepalive()` without reset) -> released ["armed","hung"]; M2 (drop the hook-registered guard) -> noReleaseHook ["armed"]; M4 (count after super) -> released hung; M5 (reset to 0) -> replaceAll/clearAll ["armed"].
findings.summary: The no-argument removeAllListeners() release branch is undiscriminated: dropping `event === undefined ||` passes every committed carrier while holding a child with no 'message' listener. One more path in ipc-message-listener-paths (`on(handler)` + `removeAllListeners()` + unref'd 'hung' timer -> ["armed"]) would protect the ADR-0448 D5 row.
